en: This is a multi-view postcard bordered in yellow, featuring four photographs of notable locations and architectural highlights in the city of Pécs. The images include a well-maintained garden with flowerbeds, a courtyard with people walking and sitting, a historic building with a clock tower on a central square, and a unique decorative fountain or monument with a sculpture of a white animal (possibly a sheep or goat) on a nearby building.
